If a "Dragunity" Monster Card(s) is in your Spell & Trap Zone: You can target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it. You can only use each effect of "Dragunity Legatus" once per turn.

name: Dragunity Legion

You can only use this effect of "Dragunity Legion" once per turn.

You can only activate 1 "Dragunity Oubliette" per turn.

name: Dragunity Phalanx

name: Dragunity Pilum

While this card is equipped to a monster  that monster can attack your opponent directly. When you do  Battle Damage inflicted to your opponent (by the equipped monster) is halved.

You can only use each effect of "Dragunity Remus" once per turn.

name: Dragunity Senatus

If a "Dragunity" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect  you can destroy 1 "Dragunity" card equipped to this card  instead.

name: Dragunity Tribus

name: Dragunity Whirlwind

If this card in your hand or field is used as Fusion Material  and sent to the GY or banished: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Dramaturge of Despia" once per turn.

name: Drastic Draw

name: Drastic Drop Off

name: Draw Discharge

name: Draw Muscle
description: Target 1 Defense Position monster you control with 1000 or less DEF; draw 1 card  also that monster cannot be destroyed by battle this turn. You can only activate 1 "Draw Muscle" per turn.

name: Draw of Fate

For the rest of this turn after this card resolves  you cannot Set Spells/Traps  also you can only activate one more card or effect. You can only activate 1 "Draw of Fate" per turn.

name: Dread Dragon

name: Dream Clown

This effect is only applied while you control a LIGHT "Dream Mirror" monster.

name: Dream Mirror of Terror

You can only activate 1 "Dream Mirror Oneiromancy" per turn.

name: Dream Shark

If Summoned this way  it loses 1000 DEF  also banish it when it leaves the field.
